notes: Abell 3526 (Walker+2013a XMM); ~300 members. Two sub-clusters: Cen30 main (NGC4696 BCG) and Cen45 infalling group (~1500 km/s offset). Most luminous classical cooling flow in any cluster; X-ray cavities around NGC4696. Cooling flow: inner zone extremely E-dominated.
